QUESTION:
What was the default value of `quota.batch_size` in PaderQueue 2.x?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0212] config | quota.batch_size (PaderQueue 2.x) | version 2.x
# `quota.batch_size` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Number of messages the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `500` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | quota |
| Unit | messages |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `quota.batch_size` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
batch_size = 500
```

---

[d0036] config | quota.batch_size | version 4.x
# `quota.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `256` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | quota |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `quota.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
batch_size = 256
```
